last_funding.notes: The company announced a $29 million Series B on March 12, 2024.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable blog index's latest post is dated July 1, 2026 and does not announce a product or major feature launch; no launch-type item in the six-month window was located.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn company profile reports a company size of 51–200, but this cannot resolve the requested narrower bands. This assertion uses the available estimate only and is uncertain.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page directs users to a live Ashby board, but its current role listings were not accessible for verification.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed public product documentation, research/blog and trust-center subprocessor information; these identify no third-party model provider as the provider powering the product.

named_customers.notes: Both are named as customers on the Customer Stories page.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The Nanonets careers page links to its Ashby board, but the accessible board did not return current job details; no live posting could be verified.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust page names these certifications/compliance claims. UK GDPR is also listed, but GDPR is represented in the required list.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Salesforce is named on the integrations page; HubSpot is named as a sales subprocessor on the trust-center subprocessor list.

product_one_liner.notes: Its homepage describes AI agents for business processes; product page describes converting complex documents into structured data.
product_one_liner.value: Nanonets provides AI agents and document-processing workflows that automate document-heavy business processes for enterprise operations teams.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The available careers/about pages do not provide a complete dated leadership roster, and no verifiable dated executive change was found.
